cond_0001.intro: The Workday Senior Analyst will provide Workday product expertise in the areas of Workday Talent and Compensation for [Company name masked]. As a key member of the HRIS team, you will provide subject matter expertise on Workday best practices and partner with HR leaders to understand pain points, prioritize requirements and identify opportunities to improve processes and gain efficiency by leveraging Workday functionality.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Create creative technology solutions to match COE needs with business processes and requirements. Create and maintain clear, comprehensive, documented business requirements for requested changes, enhancements, or projects; accountable for articulating functional processes from beginning to end and providing thought leadership on functionality and design. Maintain awareness of Workday future releases / roadmap and the potential impact of those plans on current and future Workday functionality. Ensure day-to-day systems support is balanced with strategic enhancements and projects. Responsible for the thorough testing and analysis of new Workday features and functionality and participates in release planning, accountable for regression testing, unit testing, User Acceptance testing and pre-launch testing / sign-off for new features or enhancements. Be the champion for Workday optimization and provide subject matter expertise on Workday best practices and partner with Process Owners to understand pain points, identify opportunities to improve processes and gain efficiencies. Prioritize Workday deliverables based on criticality and be able to support multiple HR teams and set expectations for all Workday deliverables. Provide training to new HR business partners and internal HR team members as needed. Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve the employee experience, reduce risk and costs, and improve compliance and controls. Partner with HR/Compensation stakeholders' teams to gain first-hand knowledge of their processes and synthesize knowledge into systems improvements.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3-5 Years of experience with Workday functional configuration across the HCM Suite of modules with specific emphasis on the Talent Optimization and Advanced Compensation modules supporting a large, global organization.
Proven Workday functional expertise - an awareness of what Workday can and cannot do, familiarity with delivered functionality and reports, and experience performing straightforward administrative tasks in Workday (Undoing tasks, manually advancing tasks, waiving requirements).
Be resourceful and have a knack for navigating challenges independently; have strong prioritization skills, communication skills, and good judgment.
Preferred Requirements
Strong sense of personal accountability for high quality, value-driven work that supports business outcomes; uses design thinking principles.
Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in HR, Business, Project Management, MIS or related field, OR a significant amount of directly related work experience beyond the minimum required for the position.

cond_0011.responsibilities: Create creative technology solutions to match COE needs with business processes and requirements. Create and maintain clear, comprehensive, documented business requirements for requested changes, enhancements, or projects; accountable for articulating functional processes from beginning to end and providing thought leadership on functionality and design. Maintain awareness of Workday future releases / roadmap and the potential impact of those plans on current and future Workday functionality. Ensure day-to-day systems support is balanced with strategic enhancements and projects. Responsible for the thorough testing and analysis of new Workday features and functionality and participates in release planning, accountable for regression testing, unit testing, User Acceptance testing and pre-launch testing / sign-off for new features or enhancements. Prioritize Workday deliverables based on criticality and be able to support multiple HR teams and set expectations for all Workday deliverables. Provide training to new HR business partners and internal HR team members as needed. Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve the employee experience, reduce risk and costs, and improve compliance and controls. Partner with HR/Compensation stakeholders' teams to gain first-hand knowledge of their processes and synthesize knowledge into systems improvements.
cond_0011.requirements: Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in Workday functional configuration across the HCM Suite of modules, with significant emphasis on the Talent Optimization and Advanced Compensation modules supporting a large, global organization. Proven Workday functional expertise — deep knowledge of what Workday can and cannot do, strong command of delivered functionality and reports, and a proven track record performing administrative tasks in Workday (Undoing tasks, manually advancing tasks, waiving requirements). Exceptional prioritization skills, communication skills, and sound judgment; able to navigate challenges independently with a resourceful, solutions-oriented approach. Strong sense of personal accountability for high-quality, value-driven work that supports business outcomes; applies design thinking principles with consistency and rigor. cond_0168.intro: The Workday Senior Analyst will provide Workday product expertise in the areas of Workday Talent and Compensation for [Company name masked]. cond_0168.responsibilities:
Create technology solutions to match COE needs with business processes and requirements.
Create and maintain clear, comprehensive, documented business requirements for requested changes, enhancements, or projects; accountable for articulating functional processes from beginning to end and actively contributing thought leadership on functionality and design.
Maintain awareness of Workday future releases / roadmap and the potential impact of those plans on current and future Workday functionality.
Ensure day-to-day systems support is balanced with strategic enhancements and projects.
Responsible for thorough testing and analysis of new Workday features and functionality; actively participate in release planning, accountable for regression testing, unit testing, User Acceptance testing and pre-launch testing / sign-off for new features or enhancements.
Be the champion for Workday optimization and share subject matter expertise on Workday best practices; connect regularly with Process Owners to understand pain points, identify opportunities to improve processes and gain efficiencies.
Prioritize Workday deliverables based on criticality and support multiple HR teams, setting clear expectations for all Workday deliverables.
Provide training to new HR business partners and internal HR team members as needed.
Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve the employee experience, reduce risk and costs, and improve compliance and controls.
Stay in close contact with HR/Compensation stakeholder teams to gain first-hand knowledge of their processes and walk them through systems improvements.
cond_0168.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3-5 Years of experience with Workday functional configuration across the HCM Suite of modules, with specific emphasis on the Talent Optimization and Advanced Compensation modules supporting a large, global organization.
Proven Workday functional expertise — an awareness of what Workday can and cannot do, familiarity with delivered functionality and reports, and experience performing straightforward administrative tasks in Workday (undoing tasks, manually advancing tasks, waiving requirements).
Resourceful and able to navigate challenges independently; strong prioritization skills, communication skills, and good judgment.
Strong sense of personal accountability for high quality, value-driven work that supports business outcomes; uses design thinking principles.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in HR, Business, Project Management, MIS, or related field.
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

cond_0330.responsibilities:
Create technology solutions to match COE needs with business processes and requirements.
Create and maintain clear, comprehensive, documented business requirements for requested changes, enhancements, or projects; accountable for articulating functional processes from beginning to end and actively contributing thought leadership on functionality and design.
Maintain awareness of Workday future releases / roadmap and the potential impact of those plans on current and future Workday functionality.
Ensure day-to-day systems support is balanced with strategic enhancements and projects.

Provide training to new HR business partners and internal HR team members as needed.
Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve the employee experience, reduce risk and costs, and improve compliance and controls.

Minimum Requirements
3-5 Years of experience with Workday functional configuration across the HCM Suite of modules, with specific emphasis on the Talent Optimization and Advanced Compensation modules supporting a large, global organization.
Proven Workday functional expertise — an awareness of what Workday can and cannot do, familiarity with delivered functionality and reports, and experience performing straightforward administrative tasks in Workday (undoing tasks, manually advancing tasks, waiving requirements).
Resourceful and able to navigate challenges independently; strong prioritization skills, communication skills, and good judgment.
Strong sense of personal accountability for high quality, value-driven work that supports business outcomes; uses design thinking principles.

Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in HR, Business, Project Management, MIS, or related field.
